title: Smart Model Router 2.0
description: Evolved version of current routing logic: dynamically choose LOCAL/Codex/Haiku/Sonnet/Opus based on task complexity, token budget, latency requirements, and cost constraints.

comments.author: alfred
comments.text: HAL dispatch started (runId: 684d7f0c-67d4-4667-8286-a04fd350aa49), but card could not be moved to in_progress due one-card rule: Signal App — Fast Track Launch is currently in_progress.

comments.author: alfred
comments.text:
HAL completed Smart Model Router 2.0 design.

Core: 2-stage routing — hard gates first (risk/code/complexity), then weighted score across Quality/Speed/Cost/Reliability with switchable modes (min/balanced/quality).

Escalation ladder: LOCAL → Haiku (or Codex for code) → Sonnet → Opus. Max 2 escalations per request.

Budget guardrails: soft cap ($2) biases down a tier; hard cap ($5) requires override.

30-day rollout: shadow mode (days 1-7) → 20-30% traffic (days 8-14) → full rollout (days 15-21) → stabilize (days 22-30).

Exit criteria: ≥20% cost reduction, <+10% p95 latency increase, retry rate flat or improved.

Ready to convert to JSON policy schema + router function for implementation on approval.

title: Project Health Command Center
description: Dashboard that aggregates project metrics across CoinUsUp, Even Us Up, Signal App, and consulting work. One-glance view of revenue, users, churn, feature velocity, blockers, and team health.

comments.author: alfred
comments.text:
HAL completed Project Health Command Center spec.

Dashboard: portfolio summary row (health score, MRR, WAU/MAU, delivery throughput, blockers) + 4 project cards (CoinUsUp/EvenUsUp/SignalApp/Consulting) each showing 6 dimensions: Revenue, Users, Churn, Feature Velocity, Blockers, Team Health.

Health score formula: Revenue 25% + Users 20% + Churn 20% + Velocity 20% + Blockers 10% + Team 5%.

Architecture: automated daily pulls (Stripe, product DB, GitHub) + 5-10 min weekly manual form for blockers/consulting pipeline → Postgres or Airtable → Metabase/Looker Studio.

30-day rollout: Phase 1 data model → Phase 2 ETL automation → Phase 3 dashboard + alerts → Phase 4 stabilize.

First instrument: CoinUsUp revenue + user activity (most mature data, fastest value).

Ultra-lean v1 KPIs (6 only): Revenue 30d, WAU, Churn%, Features shipped 14d, Open critical blockers, Team health score.

title: Weekly Wins & Impact Digest

comments.author: alfred
comments.text:
HAL completed Weekly Wins & Impact Digest format.

Delivered: reusable 6-section template (Shipped / Metrics moved / Revenue impact / Blockers resolved / Key learnings / Next week focus) with fill rules and optional momentum score.

Key rules: every shipped item needs outcome + evidence, revenue claims tagged as direct/pipeline/estimated, keep to ~1 page, use proxies if no hard metric moved.

HAL offered to produce this as a JSON schema for auto-generation every Friday. Alfred recommendation: wire this up as a Friday evening cron so it auto-populates from Kanban board data + Stripe + git log and posts to Slack weekly. Low effort, high ongoing value.

title: Communication DNA Dashboard
description: Visual map of how Joe prefers to communicate (async vs sync, channels, response time, decision-making style). Helps Alfred + team optimize for Joe's communication patterns.

comments.author: alfred
comments.text:
HAL completed Communication DNA Dashboard spec.

Key outputs:
1. Dashboard spec: 6 panels — Profile summary, Channel effectiveness matrix, Async vs sync decision widget, Decision-making pattern widget, Response reliability widget, Playbook panel
2. Data model: communication_event + preference_signal + weekly profile_snapshot with confidence scoring (source × recency × consistency)
